column1: # Shared partition table for ESP32-C5 boards with >4MB flash that run native SD
# apps from flash (CONFIG_ELF_LOADER_C5_FLASH_XIP). Identical to the stock 4MB
# partitions.csv but appends a 1MB "napps" partition holding the relocated .text

column2: so this table fits ANY C5 board with >=5MB flash

column1: # (8MB and 16MB alike — flash beyond the last partition is simply unused). The
# loader finds the partition by label/subtype at runtime
# firmware work across every >4MB C5 board. 4MB boards have no room for napps and
# the loader cleanly reports it (flash-XIP unavailable there).
# Offsets are 64KB-aligned for the C5 MMU page size.
